name: Sakuma Haruhi
source:
Same year student as the protagonist who also the director of the swimming club and one of their only three members. She hate it when called by her nickname.

[spoiler]Her attitude made her become the source of the famous [url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Main/Tsundere]"Tsundere"[/url] etymology.[/spoiler]
